# Allowlist for build-scripts/reaper_piicheck.py (run by repo-hygiene.yml).
# Two kinds of line:
#   <path or glob>   the GENERIC detectors skip that file - vendored upstream context or
#                    scrub documentation only. The private deny-list still reads it.
#   <rule>:<value>   accept one value everywhere - public infrastructure or a documented
#                    example. Rules: mail home mac ipv4 ipv6 host basic urlcred.
# Never add a file or a value that carries the maintainer's own personal details: change
# the test or doc to a documentation value instead (RFC 5737 / 3849 / 9637 / 7042).
#
# --- values ---
# firmware version strings the dotted-quad detector reads as addresses
ipv4:3.0.0.6
ipv4:8.0.7.4
# example.com's public address (dnsmap fixtures resolve example.com)
ipv4:93.184.216.34
# addresses from ASUS's own stock OUTPUT_IP block rules, replayed by the firewall-restore tests
ipv4:51.15.120.245
ipv4:45.33.73.134
# the public address of www.ipdeny.com, the country-list host Warden whitelists once so its own
# downloads are never dropped by the router-self filter (v3.4.7, rc/rwarden.c RW_GEO_HOST_IP),
# and the hosting provider's public range named in the comment beside it
ipv4:51.15.12.186
ipv4:51.15.0.0
# the classic placeholder addresses in examples and help text
ipv4:1.2.3.4
ipv4:5.6.7.8
# subnet-boundary arithmetic in the shared topbar JavaScript (patch 0046)
ipv4:126.255.255.255
ipv4:128.0.0.0
#
# --- paths ---
# the checker's own negative controls: invented real-looking values, by design
build-scripts/tests/test_piicheck.py
# patches 0103/0222/0223: third-party upstream author/translator addresses in
# deleted-file diff context and imported package metadata (pre-existing upstream).
patches/0103-www-shared-delete-AiCloud-WebDAV-CloudSync-remnants-.patch
patches/0222-add-openssh-sftp-package-bundle-sftp-server-for-SFTP.patch
patches/0223-bump-net-snmp-5.7.2-5.9.4-SNMP-hardening-batch-CVE-h.patch

# two external contributors/bug-reporters by @gmail address (public upstream
# source; not maintainer PII).
# NB: entries here are PATH-matched, so a series renumber silently invalidates
# them and the scan then reports a long-allowlisted file as a new hit. This one
# was 0291 before the 2026-08-09 repair shifted everything after 0245 by +3.
# Re-check this file after any renumber.
patches/0294-openvpn-updated-to-2.7.5.patch
# patch 0475 (OpenVPN 2.7.6 carry-forward, cut 2026-08-21): the same thing one
# release later - the upstream Changes.rst credits an external bug reporter by
# @gmail address. Public upstream source; not maintainer PII.
patches/0475-openvpn-updated-to-2.7.6.patch
# patch 0587 (Tor 0.4.9.11 carry-forward from Merlin, cut 2026-09-01 for v3.0.0):
# vendored upstream tor source carries third-party copyright-header addresses in
# its diff context - the curve25519-donna author (a bolet.org address), the
# autoconf-archive macro authors credited by external @gmail and @gmx addresses,
# and a test-fixture address in the unit tests. All public upstream source, none
# maintainer PII. The commit itself keeps Eric Sauvageau's From (honest GPL
# provenance, permitted by repo-hygiene).
# NB: do not spell out a full <name>@gmail.com here - this file is itself scanned,
# and a literal address in this comment makes the allowlist its own PII hit.
patches/0587-tor-updated-to-0.4.9.11.patch
